name: Cook Islands (1973–1979)
description: A green field with a ring of fifteen yellow five-pointed stars.
history: The first distinctive flag of the Cook Islands, chosen from 120 entries in a 1973 competition and adopted on 23 July 1973: green for the land and fifteen gold stars in a circle for the fifteen islands. It was replaced on 4 August 1979 by the present blue ensign with the ring of stars.
